headline: Wilderness River Access and High-Rim Lookout Reservations
reservation: Access to the river floor via Pittsburg Landing is generally open, but jet boat and rafting tours are the primary bottlenecks and require early booking with commercial outfitters. The U.S. Forest Service manages the Hells Canyon National Recreation Area; specific wilderness permits are required for private river trips, distinct from standard vehicle access. Always check the Wallowa-Whitman National Forest official site for changing road closures or permit lottery dates.

days.title: Confluence and Canyon Gateway

stops.name: Nez Perce National Historical Park
stops.detail: Visit the visitor center to understand the cultural significance of the canyon to the Nimiipuu people.

stops.name: Hells Canyon Jet Boat Launch
stops.detail: Board a commercial jet boat for a scenic transit into the northern gorge to see the basalt walls from the water.

days.driving: Allow 1-2 hours; conditions vary by river tour length
days.note: Supply shopping is most reliable in Lewiston before heading south.

days.title: Whitewater Capital and High Vistas

stops.name: Salmon River Whitewater
stops.detail: Participate in a guided rafting trip at the confluence of the Salmon and Snake Rivers.

stops.name: Heavens Gate Lookout
stops.detail: Drive the steep forest road for a panoramic view spanning four states and the Seven Devils Mountains.

days.driving: Allow 3 hours for mountain forest roads; conditions vary
days.note: The road to Heavens Gate is high-elevation and typically snow-blocked until late June.

days.title: River Bed History and Petroglyphs

stops.name: Pittsburg Landing
stops.detail: Reach the canyon floor to access the Snake River National Recreation Trail for a riverside hike.

stops.name: Buffalo Eddy
stops.detail: View ancient petroglyphs etched into the dark basalt rocks along the river bank.

days.driving: Allow 2 hours for steep gravel grades; conditions vary
days.note: Ensure your vehicle is equipped for washboarded gravel surfaces.

intel.title: Gateway Refueling
intel.text: Fill tanks in Lewiston or Riggins before departing for the canyon floor. Fuel is not available once you descend to Pittsburg Landing or the high rim overlooks.

intel.title: Wilderness Boundaries
intel.text: Road access to the river is limited to a few specific points like Pittsburg Landing and Hells Canyon Dam. Most of the gorge is accessible only by boat or foot.

intel.title: Seasonal Road Window
intel.text: High-altitude rim roads are often impassable from November through June. River-level access remains warmer but is subject to spring runoff levels.

intel.title: Communication Gaps
intel.text: Expect total loss of cellular service once leaving the Highway 95 corridor. Download all maps for offline use before entering the National Recreation Area.

intel.title: Trailhead Capacity
intel.text: Parking at Pittsburg Landing is generally adequate but can be tight during peak fishing seasons. Avoid blocking boat ramp access areas.

plan.arrival: Arrive at Lewiston Nez Perce County Airport (LWS), pick up a high-clearance rental, and stock up on water and dry goods in Lewiston.
plan.vehicle: High-clearance vehicles are strongly recommended for gravel access roads; check rental agreements for off-pavement restrictions.
plan.goldenHour: Heavens Gate Lookout offers dramatic sunset views across the Seven Devils, depending on seasonal cloud cover.
